Lam Yati Nazeeruka Fi Nazarin 🌹

Recited by: Qari Syed Muhammad Fasihuddin Soharwardi
Kalam: Ala Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (Rahmatullahi Alaih), Hadaiq-e-Bakhshish
Original: Bilal Amjad Soharwardy on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=XvURxcWSkJ8)
All rights belong to the reciter and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete naat on the original channel. 🤍

Lam yati nazeeruka fi nazarin, misl-e-tu na shud paida jaana / Jag raaj ko taaj tore sar so hai, tujh ko shah-e-dosara jaana: no eye has ever seen anyone like Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam); the crown of the world's kingdom is on his head, the king of both worlds.

Visuals: Pixabay (Natsu_444, DesignwithRiyas, muhammadarhamamin77800)

Taiba Ke Jaane Wale 🌹

Performed by: Sabri Brothers (Qawwal & Party)
Original: Sabri Brothers - Topic on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=ZElKozOdTPc)
All rights belong to the artists and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete qawwali on the original channel. 🤍

A lover who cannot travel asks the pilgrims going to Taiba (Madinah) to carry his story of sorrow, with great respect, to Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam).
